findings.description: Translated district fixed-effect models retain 187 observations where the article reports 186, and translated robust p-values differ for several Table 1 terms.
findings.evidence: R console output in logs/run-3.txt; printed Table 1 in article PDF.
findings.suggested_fix: Check the Stata 15 estimation sample and robust variance calculation to identify the one-observation sample discrepancy and p-value differences.

findings.description: The shipped do-file does not compute Table 2 contribution-change counts or percentages, nor the approximate marginal probabilities stated in the prose.
findings.evidence: Complete shipped do-file runs only Table 1, Figures 1–3 and Table 3 models.
findings.suggested_fix: Provide the original analysis code that generated these outputs if they are to be computationally checked.

limitations: Stata 15 was unavailable; all shipped commands were translated to R.
Table 2 descriptive figures and prose approximations are not produced by the shipped script and were not reconstructed.
The `marhis` visualization was translated as 50 grid values with average predicted probabilities; Stata package output was unavailable for exact figure comparison.
No claim is made about scientific correctness.
